findings.current: At the far end of the direction in which the middle-aged warrior was looking, a massive White Tiger took a step forward.

findings.current: Then she curled up the corners of her mouth at me.

findings.current: Jin Taekyung wanted to avoid drawing their figures into the horrific hellscape that would soon unfold here.

findings.current: And before I could even summon my internal energy again, I realized that the situation I was in still did not qualify as the worst.

findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the realization while restoring Jin’s concise, immediate narrative voice.
